description: This file defines the LambdaSL class, which is a scheduler for setting sparsity levels of model parameters during training. It extends BaseScheduler and uses user-defined functions to compute sparsity multipliers per epoch. The class is specifically used within the context of the torch.ao.pruning framework to control sparsity schedules.

classes.name: LambdaSL
classes.description: A scheduler that sets the sparsity level of each parameter group to a final scaled value times a user-defined function, updating sparsity dynamically during training.
